title: Fast arpeggio with overlap
purpose: confirms attacks within CHORD_CLUSTER_WINDOW correctly cluster as chord even if not strictly simultaneous.
expected_prose:
All three sustain past t=100, so sounding-set sees
the triad. state=chord, identity=(C, major), confidence=declared
by t=100.
trailing_notes: Tuning note: this test passes for any reasonable CHORD_CLUSTER_WINDOW and sounding-set rule. It's a sanity test, not a tuning test.
